unit.why: A short report, cited from a source, of R. Baruch of Medzhibozh's custom of reciting the Shavuot-night Tikkun and kaddishes in a minyan because of the Besht's hilula; it records a custom in a legal-customs compilation and has no narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Opening 'ושימש כל גדולי הדור' seems to lack its subject (possibly lost in OCR or carried from the heading at the end of the previous division); trailing 'מענין תמכי דאורייתא' is the heading of the next division.
